counting_boundary.authorization_confirmations: explicit or implicit human authorization boundaries, never counted as reducible internal control interactions
counting_boundary.end: one result, one artifact-bound review, and finalization acknowledgement or honest terminal limitation
counting_boundary.internal_control_interaction: a model-facing control handoff, Host action/readback, or model-issued protocol call across a process/tool boundary; in-process typed Kernel calls are reported separately as protocol_calls
counting_boundary.latency: single-machine monotonic elapsed time; diagnostic distribution, not a correctness oracle
counting_boundary.local_writes: logical preparation files plus canonical commits, excluding SQLite page/WAL implementation writes
counting_boundary.protocol_calls: accepted or rejected typed commands presented to the canonical writer
counting_boundary.start: first public entry action for the supplied semantic goal
counting_boundary.user_start_actions: public entry invocations, excluding the separately reported authorization confirmation
